data.name: Kiranya
data.gender_notes: Kiranya is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Goddess Kiranya represents the embodiment of divine knowledge and enlightenment. Her name derives from the Sanskrit words 'Kiran' (ray of light) and 'Ya' (goddess), evoking images of illuminating wisdom and spiritual growth. The name Kiranya carries the meaning “Goddess of knowledge and light” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit. Parents who choose Kiranya usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of knowledge and light and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Kiranya belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Goddess of knowledge and light.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kiranya total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

The name carries with it the weight of centuries of Hindu philosophical and spiritual teachings, adding depth and richness to any context in which it is used.
